messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
As of 14 November 2026, is the periodic verification of the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17 overdue?

response.text: {"lookups": ["P&H R200 mobile crane position 17 lifting equipment register row: verifica periodica, data ultima verifica, scadenza / periodic inspection, last inspection date, due date", "Allegato VII D.Lgs. 81/2008 verifiche periodiche gru mobili gru su autocarro periodicità / Annex VII Legislative Decree 81/2008 periodic inspection interval mobile cranes lorry-mounted cranes", "art. 71 comma 11 D.Lgs. 81/2008 verifiche periodiche attrezzature di lavoro di sollevamento / Article 71(11) Legislative Decree 81/2008 periodic verification of lifting work equipment", "P&H R200 manual inspection schedule periodic inspection interval manutenzione verifiche periodiche gru / P&H R200 operator manual maintenance intervals ispezione periodica"]}
